newsitem.title: USA: Kansas lawmakers hope for budget accord this week.
newsitem.headline: Kansas lawmakers hope for budget accord this week.

text.p: Kansas lawmakers return Wednesday to complete work on the state's estimated $3.75 billion annual general fund budget and decide whether they should re-authorize local option budgets for school districts.
Legislators hope to wrap up the work by late Friday, according to Chad Edwards, legislative assistant to Kansas House Speaker Tim Shallenburger, R-Baxter Springs.

In addition to the local option issue, legislators also must address child support enforcement efforts required by the federal welfare reform law and proposals to ban partial-birth abortions, Edwards said.

Gov. Bill Graves in January proposed a $3.75 billion general fund budget. He signed a $117 million tax relief package in early April and also signed a bill adding $36 million in funding for public schools.
